description: This file contains tests for the heartbeat runner module, specifically for the Ghost reminder bug (issue #13317). It defines test utilities, setup functions, and multiple test cases that verify the behavior of the heartbeat system in various scenarios, including cron prompts, heartbeat events, and internal prompts.

methods.name: createHeartbeatDeps
methods.description: Creates mock dependencies for the heartbeat, including mock functions for sending Telegram messages and getting replies.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Generates a configuration object for testing, configuring agents, channels, and session store, then seeds the session store.

methods.name: expectCronEventPrompt
methods.description: Asserts that the callback context contains the expected cron event prompt content.

methods.name: runCronReminderCase
methods.description: Runs a heartbeat test case specifically for cron reminder events.

methods.name: runHeartbeatCase
methods.description: Executes a generic heartbeat test case with given parameters, setting up sandbox, configuration, and assertions.
